lem:ub-good-cluster.details: Integer windows use ceil(rho log N)+1, D=ceil(6/gamma), loss of two retained. Uniform threshold precedes arrays and every fitting window. U11 owns suffix/restart construction, consuming the actual good triple.

eq:ub-reserve-mass.details: Actual deterministic least triple, two retained good tail columns, maximal mass digits elsewhere, original population throughout; each mass >=g^2*k^(-D). No existence certificate remains.

lem:ub-exploration-concentration.details: Full literal H: outside counts, prefix/later counts, both selected guard counts. Stronger all-digit-set event over (2^k)^(L+1) tests. Actual PMF Bernstein denominator4 yields c=1/24. Fixed A=2+k*T*log2 and c before N0 then all arrays. Guard scale threshold derived eventually before arrays.

eq:ub-natural-history-good.details: Separate own-pile spatial directions, no column reversal or H conditioning. Literal finite history fibers; positive represented fibers and null quotient handled. epsilon=sqrt(rbad) of deterministic source constants.

common_direction_coverage.details: Actual ranks and guard mean gap=np*middleMass. H×H excludes opposite sides at same spatial rank. R×R covers every shared graph edge by sum of exactly 2k terminal processes. Small piles and boundaries are included.

eq:ub-exploration-regularity-probability.details: Concrete collision estimate <=(k/2)n^(xi-eta). Full regularity failure <=rbad+2n*sqrt(rbad)+(k/2)n^(xi-eta) with H and actual empirical terminal mean inputs discharged internally. o(1) for 0<xi<eta; first two errors smaller than every inverse real power.

exploration_process_paragraph.details: Actual 0/1 increments. Unused small piles zero. Remaining count retains crossing edge e=i-1. Conditional remaining-edge estimate belongs to U09 and is absent from every definition.
